name: startup-hardware-marketplace
description: Hardware marketplace (Arduino, ESP32-CAM, sensors...) with full admin control

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm start --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
